content.user_title: Choose Claude Code Web or CLI
content.value_statement: Teams lose time when they pick the wrong Claude Code interface for a task. This skill recommends Web, CLI, or a hybrid handoff workflow.
actual_capabilities: Compares Claude Code Web and CLI strengths for common task types.
Recommends Web, CLI, or hybrid workflows based on complexity and testing needs.
Explains when to move a session from Web to CLI.
Provides input and output contracts for workflow planning.
Lists failure modes for dirty git state, large context, and web limitations.
Includes a process diagram for interface selection and session handoff.
limitations: Does not teleport sessions by itself.
Does not run tests, inspect repositories, or create pull requests.
Depends on current Claude Code Web and CLI feature availability.
Requires the user to follow local setup and clean git state steps.

use_cases.title: Select the Best Starting Interface
use_cases.description: Decide whether a task belongs in Claude Code Web, CLI, or a hybrid workflow before work begins.

use_cases.title: Move Work From Mobile to Desktop
use_cases.description: Plan on mobile or web, then continue locally when testing, debugging, or deeper file access is needed.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Handoffs
use_cases.description: Give teams a shared checklist for choosing tools, preserving context, and reviewing pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a coding task. Ask the minimum questions needed, then recommend Claude Code Web, CLI, or hybrid.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Web Start
prompt_templates.scenario: Simple task started away from the workstation
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me decide if this task can start in Claude Code Web. Include review steps and when to switch.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Session Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: I started in Claude Code Web and need to continue in CLI. Create a handoff checklist and risks to verify.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a Web, CLI, and review workflow for a complex feature that needs local testing.

output_examples.input: I need to update copy on one page while I am away from my laptop.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use Claude Code Web. The task is small, review can happen in a pull request, and local testing is unlikely.

output_examples.input: I need to refactor authentication and debug local login failures.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use Claude Code CLI. The task needs repeated testing, local services, and inline diffs.

output_examples.input: I began planning on mobile, but the implementation now needs local database checks.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use a hybrid workflow. Preserve the session context, prepare a clean local git state, and continue in CLI.

best_practices: Choose the interface before implementation starts.
Switch to CLI when testing, debugging, or repeated edits become central.
Verify git state and context before continuing a handed-off session.
anti_patterns: Using Web for complex debugging that needs local services.
Starting CLI work when a small review-only change would be faster in Web.
Moving sessions without checking local git state first.

faq.question: Does this skill run any commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples. The user decides whether to run any local command.

faq.question: When should I use Claude Code Web?
faq.answer: Use Web for small, clear tasks, mobile work, quick pull requests, and review-first workflows.

faq.question: When should I use Claude Code CLI?
faq.answer: Use CLI for complex edits, local testing, debugging, database work, and tasks needing detailed file exploration.

faq.question: What does hybrid mean?
faq.answer: Hybrid means starting in one interface and continuing in another when the task requirements change.

faq.question: Can this skill create pull requests?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend a workflow that includes pull request review, but it does not create pull requests.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The guidance is written for Claude Code workflows and is tagged for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility.
